unit: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston, Research Department

labs.lab_name: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston, Research Department
labs.research_summary: The central bank's economic research group, whose economists are supported by two-year research associates.
labs.join_notes: Research associates are recent graduates in economics, math, statistics or a related field, hired for two years; applicants need US citizenship. The page says to send a cover letter to the recruiting manager, with resume, writing sample, transcript and two reference letters (one from an economics professor) emailed to Bos.RA.Recruiting@bos.frb.org. Research Department summer internship questions go to ResearchIntern.BOS@bos.frb.org.
labs.notes: The target start page timed out twice, so no people or lead were read. The RA program page was reached through a link on the Boston Fed careers page. Department is not a lab; no member count. Page names a recruiting manager and a business support specialist but no research lead.

notes: Start page https://www.bostonfed.org/careers/economic-research failed to load (timeout) on the original fetch and again on a retry. Used 1 extra page.
